correctness.rationale: The included independently reconstructible checker exhausts all 65536 vertex subsets, derives the exact 2-forest face vector, builds each signed integral boundary and eliminates every nonzero entry by 7390 integer unit pivots across dimensions, certifying all nonzero Smith invariant factors equal 1. Ranks give only integral integral homology free of rank 129 in degree six. The two-skeleton is complete, giving simple connectivity; Hurewicz and Whitehead imply the 129-sphere wedge. Terminal mod-two ranks, Euler characteristic, and universal coefficients prove rational H6 rank9. A direct mod-two cycle-inclusion calculation has image rank9, which forces rational rank9 because the terminal free rank equals the mod-two Betti number. Separate DFS enumeration cross-checks all faces. No infinite or unknown graph family is inferred.

value.rationale: A canonical small Cartesian cube supplies a natural first substantial computation at the interior degree-two stage of the recently introduced forest filtration. The 129-dimensional integral homotopy class and exact 120-dimensional rational death kernel measure topology and persistence, not a mere face count, extremal size, or stage-zero independence result. The exact case is a reproducible structural benchmark and supplies the terminal surviving-image invariant, without asserting a general family theorem.
